scope: Explicit original-id queries, original-authorizer same-command resends, safe retirement, original-fact confirmation and pure current-action projection
checks: Current original-round field and independent-finance access is rechecked before writes and successful idempotent replay; applicants, original cashier, hidden-field admin and other tenants cannot act
All routes bind actual report, application, round, original settlement and partial adjustment versions; original queries additionally require explicit actual accrual/payment/payment-voucher versions
A preparation read failure can recover unknown original finance through original-id queries without creating a new payment, posting or partial operation
Budget and accrual queries are independent; completed queries preserve immutable local completion and need explicit source confirmation
Only the original authorizer can explicitly resend a confirmed NOT_FOUND operation under its existing unexpired command; success on either side never resends
Two never-dispatched queues retire atomically, become unusable and release only this adjustment return claim; unknown, NOT_FOUND and disputed or applied effects do not qualify
Retirement competing with worker claim is serialized by the same original report lock; no surviving runnable retired command or incorrectly released claim
Unknown original sources retain query capability while retirement, new sends and confirmation remain unavailable
Current-source confirmation retains exact original completion and actual source versions; an unresolved financial dispute cannot be cleared by this action
An incomplete successor cannot confirm while prior completed adjustments require review; historical completed adjustment can confirm without being the latest
Audit failures separately roll back retirement/return release, all three original queries, and source confirmation together with idempotency occupation
Pure GET capabilities do not mutate state or send finance requests; successful replies use no-store and do not expose raw accounts or command/target digests
Relevant previous preparation, completion, original-full-reversal and resource tests pass in H2 and isolated PostgreSQL
